title: Termwise coproducts in a Grothendieck derived category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and let $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ be the localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every set $I$ in the chosen indexing universe and family of unbounded cochain complexes $(K_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$, the termwise coproduct complex $(\bigoplus_iK_i)^r=\bigoplus_i K_i^r$, with differential induced by the $d_i^r$, exists. Its image $Q(\bigoplus_iK_i^\bullet)$, with the images of the termwise coprojections, is a coproduct of the $Q(K_i^\bullet)$ in $D(\mathcal A)$. The assertion includes the empty set.
